sources.snippet: Overview whisper-large-v3-turbo is an automatic speech recognition and speech translation model created by openai, designed for fast transcription of audio files with minor quality trade-offs. The model is a pruned version of whisper-large-v3 with the decoding layers reduced from 32 to 4, making it substantially faster while maintaining strong generalization across diverse audio domains and ...
